hypothesis: NO-side mention miscalibration may survive conservative taker quote/cost accounting; this is a necessary-condition screen, never executable profit proof.
series_selection: First30 SHA256 mention-v1|ticker from immutable current official Mentions registry; current-registry survivorship remains a limitation.
discovery: Historical endpoint max2pages x1000 per series. Every uncompleted cursor recorded; incompleteness prevents representative-population claims.
event_selection: Project only ticker,event_ticker,open_time,close_time,expected_expiration_time,expiration_time,occurrence_datetime,market_type,rules_primary,rules_secondary. Retain binary contracts closed within fixed range; first120 event hashes mention-v1|event_ticker; one smallest contract hash mention-v1|ticker per event. Never substitute after price/result inspection.
decision: Earliest supplied close/expected-expiration/occurrence timestamp minus24h. Require open_time <= decision. Use only minute candle ending at floor(decision/60)*60, never future or nearest trade. Require 0 < yes_bid <= yes_ask <1, spread <=0.05; NO ask=1-yes_bid within[0.20,0.80].
settlement: Hold one analytical contract to official yes/no binary resolution; invalid/missing labels remain unresolved.
costs: ceil(100*0.07*p*(1-p)) cents benchmark taker entry; extra2c and extra5c per entry reported. Unknown actual series fees prevent qualification.
execution_limits: Candles have no proven executable depth or quote receipt/activation latency
Earliest historical times/rules may have revised; historical vintage unverified
No maker fill shares; no midpoint entries
A positive screen alone cannot qualify any Demo or live order
automatic_stop: Negative stressed results rejects this fixed screen; incomplete data remains incomplete. Never optimize/invert it on these observations.
